frame_policy: 16 equally spaced bin centers inside a conservatively trimmed mapped cutting interval; nearest unique native decoded frame; no frame repetition/padding
alignment_policy: label-blind shared audio timing where available; filename offsets are hypotheses only; independent multi-anchor and held-out checks; no anomaly-label optimization
rationale: The near-tool S0 audio provides weak local timing evidence on dataset1. Obtain one independent synchronized ambient microphone channel to test the timing hypothesis without labels.
